If you’re new here, hi! I’m Amy Porterfield 👋

I’ve been in business for 17 years, and in that time, so much has changed. This year, I changed my entire business model to focus on one thing: coaching female founders.

Why? Because when I was trying to grow from half a million to a million, I desperately needed a coach and a mentor. Someone who had already been where I was going. And that support is what helped me get from my first million all the way to $139M.

A woman needs another woman who has gone before her to help her make those big pivots. Someone who can see what’s getting in the way and show her what to do next.

So if you’re a high earning female founder sitting in the several hundred thousand range, and your revenue is plateauing (or even sliding backward), I’m here to help you hit your first million.

I put together a free training.

Comment TRAINING and I’ll send it your way. 👇

I can’t wait to help you get there, my friend. 💛

Not everyone in your corner can tell you what’s holding your business back 👀

I’ve spent 17 years helping female founders find the gold mine they’re already sitting on.

In my free training I’ll help you find yours.
